source.section: Rule #3 (Finals Round, determining the results from the majority mark), item 4 (p.3; PDF page 3, printed number not confirmed)
source.quote_free_summary: Within the finals-round majority mark: the majority mark is the middle mark with an odd number of judges; an even number may be used for contingency or emergency purposes, with the majority mark one more than half the marks. No minimum number of judges is stated.

requirement: Odd panel preferred (warning); even panel permitted as a contingency using the stated majority mark. No minimum is invented.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6C): _compoc_blockers_panel_size / _compoc_panel_rules for the declared body. Not built.
interpretation_notes: NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE: any UCWDC minimum panel size or chair requirement. The Studio engines fail closed on even panels, so the contingency case is unsupported. NOT IMPLEMENTED (design only, PR-A section 6C): a BLOCKER to activating this body profile; no test; no compliance claimed. Hard blocker if mandatory, warning if advisory.
